attractions.name: Gavi Safari
attractions.description: Full-day jeep safari passing the border of Periyar Tiger Reserve through hills, valleys, tropical forests, grasslands, waterfalls, cardamom plantations, Pamba Reservoir and reserve forest. Chances of sighting wildlife such as Nilgiri tahr and lion-tailed macaque. Over 320 bird species, and the endemic Nageia wallichiana is seen only around Gavi in the Western Ghats.
